description: A small mod that adds cool sounds for Ice Boating.

mods.name: Ice Boat Racing Sounds
mods.description: Motor-Sounds für Boote (ideal für Ice-Boat-Racing): Start-Sound, drehzahlabhängiger Loop und Abstell-Sound.

releases.notes:
**Ice Boat Racing Sounds – v1.0.0 (First Release)**

> Race car sound on ice – audio only, 100% vanilla physics.

Boats and rafts sound like race cars on ice (Ice / Packed / Blue / Frosted): `engine_start` on touchdown, 5 simulated gears with shift bangs and rev-matching, rev-limiter stutter, turbo whine + blow-off, overrun pops, wind, drift squeal, and collision sounds. Includes start-stop automatics, quiet nearby boats, and smooth fade-out on dismount.

Important: Changes **sound only**. Speed, handling and rules stay vanilla – server-fair. All OGGs self-synthesized, royalty-free and seamlessly loopable. Client-side only.

**Requires:** Minecraft 1.21.4 + Fabric Loader + Fabric API
**Config:** `config/ice-boat-racing-sounds.json` (volumes & toggles)
